sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed regarding an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern identified under case AC-HHF-004. The activity involves customer C12975 and debit card C12975-K2, linked to a coordinated low-and-slow micro-charge skimming wave targeting 16 connected cards including C00129-K1 and C00348-K1. On 2017-01-05 at 11:33, transaction 3660255 for $3.51 was conducted online in region 191.0, followed on 2017-01-07 at 10:03 by online transaction 3660256 for $5.18 in region 191.0. Online transaction 3660257 for $2.66 occurred on 2017-01-14 at 14:57 in region 191.0, followed on 2017-01-18 at 14:42 by online transaction 3660258 for $4.75 in region 191.0. On 2017-01-22 at 13:22, online transaction 3660259 for $4.99 was executed in region 191.0 using device profile rv:11.0 | NULL | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL, and on 2017-01-26 at 15:09, online transaction 3660260 for $2.90 occurred in region 337.0. This pattern of repeated low-value online micro-charges is inconsistent with the cardholder's prior baseline of 198 transactions as of opening, which had a median amount of $57.99 and maximum amount of $822.54. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (1 earlier closed case(s), none reported), and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Case AC-HHF-004 was opened on 2017-01-26, connected cards were placed on monitoring, the case was escalated to an analyst, a block of card C12975-K2 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval for total suspicious exposure of $23.99.
